sources.title: Law No. 40/AN/19/8ème L: conditions for entry and stay of foreigners
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Journal serves the 2019 entry-and-stay law. Articles 15 and 16 split consular and eVisa visa issuance by the applicant’s country of application; Article 51 repeals the older 2007 and 2010 regimes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les demandeurs ... en provenance des pays où la République de Djibouti ne possède pas de représentations ... système électronique E-Visa.

sources.title: E-Government: eVisa
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The public E-Government portal identifies ANSIE as the State information-systems agency and says its administrative information is certified and validated by relevant administrations. It proves delivery mechanics, not nationality eligibility.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: Djibouti Immigration eVisa official applicant portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live gouv.dj applicant frontend calls protected master-code endpoints for countries and nationalities. Normal unauthenticated GET replay of its published master-data endpoint returns 403; its publicly rendered terms identify no nationality cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: conditions of eligibility concerning the online application for an electronic visa are kept up to date.
